pages.text: $(bold)The Nanshan Rod$()$(br)The mods core tackle; press $(bold)[B]$() to open the modification screen.

$(bold)Numeric Assembly$()$(br)Six part types - body, reel, line, float, sinker and bait - each carry their own stats: tension, hardness, stretch, drag, reel speed, thickness, weight, current resistance, size, conspicuousness... the feel of the rod is entirely your build.
$(bold)Bait & Diet$()$(br)Herbivores take Grass Bait, carnivores Meat Bait, scavengers Rot Bait, live-prey feeders Earthworms; omnivores are not picky.
